issues.description: url = "" — the recipe 'url' attribute is empty. While the exact forbidden pattern 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is not present, an empty url is still a template placeholder per the spirit of rule 5. Should be filled with the recipe repository URL (e.g. the cnb.cool制品仓 URL).
issues.recommendation: Set url to the recipe repository address, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/.../lzo" or remove the attribute if not applicable.

issues.rule: code-style §16 (import 顺序 / 未使用 import)
issues.description: import os is only referenced in a commented-out line (L34). The import is effectively unused in executable code.
issues.recommendation: Remove 'import os' or uncomment the self.run(...) alternative if intended.

issues.description: All three patch_classification entries have guard: 'pending', indicating the patch guard analysis was not finalized. This is metadata-only and does not affect build correctness, but suggests the classification step was left incomplete.
issues.recommendation: Finalize guard analysis (e.g. set to 'none' if no #ifdef guard applies, or the actual guard name).

issues.rule: code-style §12 (补丁文件规范 — patch_description 格式)
issues.description: patch_description values use descriptive sentences ('Update cmake_minimum_required for newer CMake versions') instead of the recommended numbered format '0001 xxx' shown in the code-style example. The descriptions are meaningful and use spaces (not hyphens), so this is a minor format deviation.
issues.recommendation: Consider aligning to the 'NNNN description' format, e.g. '0001 update cmake minimum required'.

summary: Audit of lzo 2.10 Conan recipe (branch feat/lzo-2.10, 11 changed files) against code-style.md and review-memory.md rules. All 8 key checks PASS: (1) R34 — test_package/test.c is a substantive test calling lzo_init(), lzo1x_1_compress(), and lzo1x_decompress() with a full compress→decompress→verify round-trip; (2) conandata.yml sha256 'c0f892943208266f9b6543b3ae308fab6284c5c90e627931446fb49b4221a072' is valid 64-hex, confirmed against ConanCenter official recipe, not a placeholder; (3) all 3 conandata patch_file paths match actual patch files in patches/; (4) manifest.yaml patches_applied exactly matches conandata.yml patch names (all 3); (5) no bare shell env vars (R33) — conanfile.py uses CMakeToolchain, no os.environ; (6) no settings.os == comparison (R32) — CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME is set unconditionally; (7) manifest status 'built' is a valid, non-fake status consistent with notes.md; (8) no binary artifacts (.so/.a/.o) or forbidden state files in the PR. Additional compliance verified: Conan 2.x API, official HTTPS source URL (oberhumer.com), correct method order, package_info.libs=['lzo2'], shebang+docstring, patch_type='portability', no CRLF, no TODO/FIXME in recipe code, test() calls cmake.test() not pass/skip. Only P2/P3 issues found (empty url field, unused import, pending guard metadata, patch_description format) — no P0/P1 blocking issues. Verdict: PASS.
